Trump FDA nominee faces Senate hearing on healthcare, vaccines, abortion

A nominee selected by former President Donald Trump to lead the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) faced a Senate hearing where they were questioned on universal healthcare demands, vaccines, and abortion. During the hearing, the nominee repeatedly sidestepped questions regarding universal healthcare. The nominee was also expected to face questions on vaccines and abortion.
